query: Economist/YouGov generic congressional ballot September 2026 Democratic margin

results.content:
A survey from YouGov/Economist released on Tuesday shows that in a generic congressional vote, 36 percent of U.S. adults would pick the Democratic candidate compared to 31 percent who would pick the Republican candidate. One percent said other, eight percent said not sure and 23 percent said they would not vote.

The poll surveyed 1,592 U.S. adults from August 28-31 and had a margin of error of 3.5 percent. # How Democrats’ November Polling Lead Compares to Trump’s First Midterm

Published

Sep 08, 2026 at 06:25 PM EDT

Andrew Stanton

Reporter

Democrats’ lead over Republicans on the generic ballot in the 2026 midterms is more modest compared to their advantage during President Donald Trump’s first midterm in 2018, even as his administration's popularity falls to record lows in the latest polls.
